page.notes: The section numbers XIV to XVIII are set apart on their own lines but are bare numerals, so they are written as paragraphs. The page number is printed as "223", with the 3 in a worn form. The catchword at the lower right is hard to read; the reading "IVN-" is doubtful. "Sforcia" is a doubtful reading of a name that is partly blurred. The ę and æ ligatures are copied as printed. The printed hyphen at the line end in "adje-ctę" is closed up.
